model_interpretation.claim: Mapping each warp to 32 adjacent X values should coalesce the eight direct neighbor-load streams, unlike the parent's narrow-X tile, while eliminating shared-memory staging and barriers. The eight loads per output may increase redundant traffic, so compare against the valid 3.5815 µs baseline without assuming a speedup.

items.subject: Coalesced direct-global one-output-per-thread kernel
items.objective: In src/candidate.cu, investigate a single direct-global-load kernel with one output per thread and no shared memory or per-thread multi-output reuse. Map each warp to adjacent X outputs at a fixed Y and Z, then compare suitable block/grid mappings and boundary-index handling. For each neighbor coordinate q=j+d, match the supplied boundary convention: add 63 if q<0, subtract 63 if q>63, otherwise leave q unchanged. Preserve in-range index 63; do not assume endpoint planes are equal. Compute all eight neighbors with the supplied coefficients and produce every output without modifying inputs or relying on scratch contents. Validate signed varying inputs, including independent endpoint values, against the oracle and compare repeated official full-run timings with the baseline.
